profile.headline: Software Developer at Ministry Brands
profile.summary: I am a dedicated software engineer with a unique blend of technical expertise and a strong sales background. My professional journey has been guided by my passion for projects that demand both creative thinking and analysis. My commitment lies in finding innovative solutions that address the needs of customers and clients. I thrive on the opportunity to both learn and share knowledge, recognizing that this collaboration is a cornerstone of my personal and career growth. My fascination with technology began at a young age, when I worked with my grandfather, delving into computer systems and programming. This early exposure ignited my desire to explore the ever-evolving world of technology. Over time, my curiosity grew stronger, not only for the technical aspects but also the strategic landscape of technology within the corporate world. This drive for understanding led me to embark on a transformative journey with NSS, where I have embraced the opportunity to learn the intricacies of technology and gain a comprehensive understanding of what truly powers the technology I have grown to cherish.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Hands on application of OOP fundamentals and SOLID principles through
group and individual projects reflecting real world business problems
• Source code version control with Git/GitHub
• JavaScript fundamentals modular, readable code, and
reusable components
• Built single-page applications with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript libraries
like React
• Task Automation with Grunt: Linting with ESLint, module bundling with
Browserify, SASS compilation
• Styled applications with CSS Frameworks Bootstrap and Bulma and
wrote custom styles with SASS
• Utilized Razor for creating and editing MVC applications
• Created and modified database design/content using SQL, Dapper, and Entity Framework with migrations

positions.title: Assistant Store Manager
positions.description:
• Manage shop staff scheduling to ensure efficient operations
• Lead all on-boarding and new staff education and training
• Implement innovative promotions to drive store revenue
• Maintain composure in times of stress
• Ensure optimized inventory to keep low costs while maintaining product availability
• Collaborate with local businesses to host events in our community

positions.title: Department Manager/ Keyholder
positions.description:
•Responsible for cleanliness, maintenance, and presentation of my assigned department
•Maintain proper floor coverage of your zone and continuously monitor my department
•Create displays of products to better highlight and create ease of shopping experience in my department
•Handle all opening and closing store procedures when ASM or SM were not in shop

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
•Trained and worked in all departments of the store
•Worked with our register systems for both checkout and product research purposes 
•Assisted ASM and Back of House Manager with processing, scanning, and organizing new shipment of products
•Assisted in all opening and closing procedures in shop
